description: Deletes a development resource (used to link Figma design elements to external developer information like code or tasks) from a specified Figma file.

inputSchema.description: Defines the `file_key` and `dev_resource_id` for deleting a dev resource.

dev_resource_id.description: Identifier of the dev resource to delete from the file.
dev_resource_id.title: Dev Resource Id

file_key.description: Identifier of the Figma file from which to delete the dev resource. Must be a main file key, not a branch key.
file_key.title: File Key

inputSchema.title: DeleteDevResourceRequest

name: delete_dev_resource

DeleteDevResourceResponse.description: Response from deleting a dev resource. Nothing is returned from this endpoint on successful deletion (HTTP 204 No Content or 200 OK with empty body).
DeleteDevResourceResponse.title: DeleteDevResourceResponse
